title: JEV-style typed state/decision PoC
working_tree: uncommitted; new isolated package openviking/jev and its tests are the only changes in this task footprint
scope: Isolated, deterministic, offline research PoC. Adopts the design idea 'state + typed question -> structured decision' from the Eigent/TypeSafe JEV material. Does NOT claim a JEV service is integrated, does NOT use local model weights, and is NOT wired into core ingestion/retrieval/Wiki traversal.
implemented_items: openviking/jev/state.py: frozen dataclasses + explicit enums (Applicability, EvidenceKind, ScoreLabel, FaultSemantics, DecisionKind, QuestionKind) for DiagnosticState/Evidence/CandidateFault/DeviceContext/CompletedCheck/AvailableCheck and Decision/RankedCandidate/NextCheck; invalid input rejected via StateValidationError instead of silent coercion.

openviking/jev/engine.py: pure deterministic engine decide(state, Question) -> Decision; ranking from observed-evidence mass with applicability gating; next-check selection by discrimination coverage then lowest cost; ABSTAIN when no candidates/evidence; NEEDS_MORE_INFO when applicability undetermined under a known config anchor or evidence is indecisive; compare_initial_order flags only material (margin > 0.25) reorderings; with_calibration relabels score->probability only when calibrated=True.

Single-fault mutually-exclusive vs multi-fault independent-event semantics kept separate: only the mutually-exclusive ranking is normalized to sum 1; independent-event scores retain raw mass and are never force-normalized.

openviking/jev/calibration.py: Brier score, expected calibration error, equal-width reliability curve, and a labeling gate where only an independent non-synthetic gold set authorizes the probability label; synthetic sets can never be labeled probability.

tests/enterprise_kb/test_jev_poc.py: 61 tests covering typed-state rejection, decision content (ranking/next check/evidence/abstain/needs_more_info), single vs multi fault semantics, score-vs-probability labeling, Brier/ECE/reliability on a synthetic labeled set, initial-order disagreement evaluation, and TC-12.4 core-unaffected checks.

verification.warnings_note: pre-existing pydantic deprecation warnings from openviking/resource/watch_manager.py; not introduced by this task
verification.ruff: NOT_RUN (ruff binary not installed in this environment); line-length<=100 and unused-import scan done manually

tc_coverage_partial.TC-12.1: C/U: typed candidate ranking + next check + evidence URIs returned; ABSTAIN when evidence insufficient; no state auto-fabrication. Covered by test_jev_poc.py.
tc_coverage_partial.TC-12.2: Q: compare_initial_order evaluates disagreement by engine margin, not mechanical equality with Profile order. Covered; real independent gold set NOT_RUN.
tc_coverage_partial.TC-12.3: Q: default label is score; probability label gated on calibration report; single vs multi fault semantics differ and neither is force-normalized to 1. Brier/ECE/reliability computed on a synthetic labeled set only.
tc_coverage_partial.TC-12.4: I: core modules under openviking/ contain no reference to openviking.jev; core wiki modules import without loading the PoC; engine is pure and does not mutate state. Covered by test_jev_poc.py.

not_run: Real independent diagnostic gold set (independent root-cause confirmed cases) for Brier/ECE/reliability calibration.
Any real model or JEV service integration; no local weights exist or are used.
Integration of the PoC into Wiki ingestion/retrieval/diagnostic hot path; it is intentionally not wired in.
Evaluation of engine ranking against confirmed root cause + check cost on real cases (TC-12.2 requires a real independent set).
Live probability labeling: no calibrated independent gold set was available, so outputs remain labeled score.

core_unchanged_evidence.check: recursive scan of openviking/**/*.py excluding the jev package for 'openviking.jev', 'from .jev', 'import jev' -> no matches
core_unchanged_evidence.import_isolation_test: subprocess imports openviking.wiki.schema/validation/resolver and asserts no openviking.jev module is loaded

limitations: PoC only: no claim that a JEV service is integrated or that local weights exist.
Scores remain uncalibrated 'score' values; the probability label is only reachable via a calibration report from an independent non-synthetic gold set that does not yet exist.
Evidence weights and MIN_SUPPORT/REORDER_MARGIN constants are deterministic heuristics for the PoC, not calibrated parameters.
TC-12.2/TC-12.3 quality acceptance on real data remains NOT_RUN; only synthetic/unit-level behavior is verified.
